newsitem.title: USA: IntegraMed says fraud dismissal upheld.
newsitem.headline: IntegraMed says fraud dismissal upheld.

text.p: An appellate court in New York upheld a ruling last year that dismissed claims of fraud brought against IntegraMed America Inc, the company said on Wednesday.
The ruling affirmed a trial court's refusal to treat a previous case as a class action, and its move to dismiss fraud claims filed against the company, IntegraMed said.
In addition, the appellate division of state Supreme Court in New York modified the prior order, dismissing all consumer fraud claims.
The decision leaves the individual plaintiffs with a single claim that alleges a lack of informed consent, the company said.
IntegraMed America is a physician practice management company specializing in women's health care.
